origin.description: Removes value labels. SPSS user missings become NA unless user_na is true.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A vector or a data frame.

arguments.name: user_na
arguments.text: When false, SPSS user missings are replaced with NA.

origin.details: The labelled class is removed. On a data frame every column is updated.
origin.value: An unlabelled vector, or the data frame.
origin.example:
x <- labelled_spss(c(1:4, 9), c(good = 1, bad = 5), na_values = 9)
print(zap_labels(x))

translation.description: Removes value labels. SPSS user missings become NA unless user_na is true.
